title: DV Evidence Pipeline Model
description: Execute legal constrained-random and intentional-negative traffic checkpoints, inspect retained ownership and capacity state, and trace each requirement through stimulus, checker, coverage, and reviewed evidence.
learnerQuestion: How does a DV plan distinguish legal stimulus, intentional negative testing, and evidence-backed signoff?

configurations.label: Legal regression
configurations.description: Only protocol-legal traffic within the declared interface capabilities.

configurations.label: Negative campaign
configurations.description: Malformed stimulus is isolated, labeled, and checked for the configured containment behavior.

scenarios.label: Topology and resource contention
scenarios.description: Different targets can progress concurrently while same-target requests wait for an implementation-defined arbitration decision; overlapping decode is a separate invalid system state.

checks.label: Independent resources can progress
checks.evidence: Concurrency follows the implemented topology and available resources, not the word bus alone.

checks.label: One accepted owner for constrained resource
checks.evidence: The selected policy chooses one request; the protocol does not mandate round robin.

steps.label: Overlapping decode
steps.event: One accepted address selects S0 and S1

checks.label: Decode must select one response owner
checks.evidence: The model flags overlapping configured address-map ownership instead of calling it arbitration.

scenarios.label: Sampling, X, and metastability
scenarios.description: A simulation X near a sampled edge is evidence to investigate; it does not prove a physical analog metastability event.

steps.label: Observe X
steps.event: RTL monitor samples X at the configured clock edge

checks.label: Do not equate X with metastability
checks.evidence: Analog setup/hold and CDC analysis, not a four-state value alone, establish the physical risk.

checks.label: Preserve CDC investigation
checks.evidence: The verification plan retains the clock/reset-domain evidence and sampled edge.

scenarios.label: Accepted-event reconstruction
scenarios.description: The monitor creates state only at protocol acceptance points and the scoreboard stays within configured depth.

steps.label: Offer
steps.event: VALID without READY / visible AHB address with HREADY LOW

checks.label: No allocation before acceptance
checks.evidence: A visible or offered request is not yet an accepted transaction.

checks.label: Legal stimulus lane
checks.evidence: The regression lane contains only generated traffic allowed by the selected protocol configuration.

checks.label: Allocate on accepted event
checks.evidence: The phase-aware monitor captures owner, attributes, and expected response state on the accepting edge.

checks.label: Configured outstanding limit
checks.evidence: The checker compares live depth with the declared implementation capability.

checks.label: Allocation/completion balance
checks.evidence: Completed-phase sampling retires exactly one previously allocated transaction.

scenarios.label: Intentional invalid stimulus
scenarios.description: An illegal request is not counted as legal coverage and must carry an explicit expected-containment contract.

checks.label: Do not pollute legal bins
checks.evidence: Intentional protocol violations use separate tests and result accounting.

checks.label: Configured containment observed
checks.evidence: The protocol might not define recovery; the product negative-test plan defines the expected containment evidence.

traceability.coverage: negative tests, excluded from legal closure
